$description: SYNAPSE Chromatic — semantic tokens. Meaning-bound, theme-aware aliases. These are the tokens emitted as CSS custom properties and Tailwind utilities. Components reference ONLY these, never primitives.

surface.$description: Elevation ramp — canvas (page) to overlay (modals/popovers). v1.2.0 Obsidian: deeper canvas, LARGER lightness steps so elevation reads through surface contrast alone (borderless depth, ADR-045).

border.$description: Borders are EARNED in the Obsidian system (ADR-045): interactive affordances, table rules, and alert states — never default panel chrome (dark theme; light keeps hairlines; hc keeps strong borders).

text.$description: Type hierarchy — primary (body), secondary (labels), tertiary (muted), inverse (on coloured fills). v1.2.0 widens the secondary/tertiary spread so the hierarchy is visible, not just measurable.

brand.$description: SYNAPSE system identity — the warm-brass cognition hue (H65, v1.3.0/ADR-046); shares the tier family. The accent is RATIONED to one primary action per surface ('quiet foundation, loud meaning'). Dark theme: a bright gold base carries a near-black label (clears APCA secondary). Light theme: a deeper bronze base carries a white label (gold is intrinsically light, so the solid affordance is darkened to keep white-text contrast).

agent.$description: 8 agent identities — categorical, Hue axis. Scoped to identity affordances only.

confidence.$description: Confidence zones bounded by the I-5 gates. low < 0.70 <= escalation < 0.80 <= autonomous; peak is the 1.00 anchor of the continuous scale.

state.$description: State feedback — separated from agent colours by lightness/chroma (INV-CLR-014/015). degraded + synthetic are the v1.1.0 honesty states (ADR-044): degraded marks any output produced on a fallback path (chroma-drained, INV-CLR-016); synthetic marks traffic-generator decisions.

motion.$description: Motion tokens — all consuming components must respect prefers-reduced-motion (INV-CLR-013). v1.1.0 (ADR-044): urgent is the escalation pulse — exactly half the 2400ms ambient pulse, because urgency is encoded as FREQUENCY, not a new colour; arrive is the decision-arrival entrance, between base and slow; entrance is a hard-decelerate curve for elements entering the stage.

factor.$description: Agent process-state grammar (ADR-044): identity hue is FROZEN (INV-CLR-012); what an agent is DOING is encoded as chroma rationing — a scalar factor applied to the identity colour's chroma (the rationedAgentColor pattern). Strictly monotone with cognitive activity (INV-CLR-017): an interrupted agent is nearly achromatic, an acting agent burns at full identity. escalated stays at full chroma and composes with the danger ring + urgent pulse (a composition rule, not a colour); recovered is a motion event, not a colour.
